facts: Provider is a wrapper around InheritedWidget, often used with ChangeNotifier.

en.label: Flutter state package
en.name: Provider
en.summary: Pass dependencies with a thin InheritedWidget wrapper.
en.description: ChangeNotifier plus Provider is a long-standing Flutter pattern. Rebuild control and compile-time safety are weaker than Riverpod.
tradeOffs: Weaker codegen and typing than Riverpod
avoidWhen: A new app that wants compile-time safety and easy tests

zh.label: Flutter 状态包
zh.name: Provider
zh.summary: 用薄的 InheritedWidget 包装来传递依赖。
zh.description: ChangeNotifier + Provider 是沿用很久的 Flutter 模式。重建范围控制与编译期安全弱于 Riverpod。
tradeOffs: 代码生成与类型安全弱于 Riverpod
avoidWhen: 新应用且重视编译期安全与可测性
